title: Prevent OOM with the right eviction policy and sizing
intent: Checks the answer sets a deliberate eviction policy, sizes to peak/P95 with headroom, and bounds big keys.
prompt: Review this Azure Managed Redis cache that is hitting out-of-memory write failures and fix the configuration.

input_artifacts.name: cache-sizing.txt
input_artifacts.content: role: pure cache; maxmemory-policy: noeviction; sized for average memory only; one key is an ever-growing list appended on every event; P95 memory ~85% of average-based size; symptom: OOM command errors under load

embedded_defects.defect: noeviction on a pure cache causes write failures at capacity.
Sized for average memory instead of peak/P95 with headroom.
An unbounded big-key list keeps growing.
